description_en: Accurately detects key information from real estate certificates, including owner details, property address, area size, land rights type, and more. It supports recognition of various property certificates issued across different regions in China
description_zh: 可准确识别不动产证中的各项关键信息，包括户主信息、房屋地址、面积大小、土地权利类型等，适用于全国各地的不同房产证识别
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-estate-certification --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1idy2XDZmx1VjSZFGXXax2XXa-713-1133.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEstateCertification

parameters.help_en:
This field and the BODY field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和BODY字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP, upload the binary file by placing it in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
